topic: Need for cleaning the electrical connectors Use of heavy-duty cleaner, cleaning fluid for electrical, electronics and allied components.

specific_objectives: 13.1.4.1 knowledge on Safety precautions & Practical on cleaning of connecters, terminals.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Practical on cleaning of connectors, terminals using heavy-duty cleaner and cleaning fluid for electrical components.
intro_questions: Why are electrical connectors critical in avionics systems?
What are the common causes of connector failure in aircraft?
List three safety precautions required before handling cleaning fluids.

development.content:
Need for cleaning electrical connectors
Types of contamination in avionics
Consequences of dirty connectors
Selection of cleaning agents
Properties of heavy-duty cleaner

Safety precautions for cleaning fluids
Handling electrical components safely
Proper disposal of waste fluids
Personal protective equipment usage
Ventilation requirements in workspace

Practical cleaning of connectors
Application of cleaning fluid
Inspection of cleaned terminals
Drying and reassembly procedures
Verification of electrical continuity

summary_questions: Explain the primary reason for using heavy-duty cleaner on electrical connectors.
Describe the correct procedure for applying cleaning fluid to a terminal.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between cleaning fluids for general electronics and those specific to avionics, referencing the next lesson on motor operations.
